body: After dinner, ※8⛬ no longer paid attention to ※2⛬, who was relaxing and resting nearby, and turned back to his room.
His gaze fell directly on the three incubators in the room, with a hint of anticipation and concern in his eyes.
He gently stepped forward, carefully took out the ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ ※9⛬ Eggs, and held them in his hands, examining them closely.
After a detailed inspection, he found that the ※0⛬ injected last night did not seem to have any adverse effects on the ※9⛬ Eggs.
Instead, it was all beneficial, which finally put his worried mind at ease.
At this time, the incubation period for these two ※9⛬ Eggs showed only three days remaining.
※8⛬ thought for a moment, without much hesitation, and decided to inject 10% of ※0⛬ into each of them again.
After the injection was completed, he habitually checked again, but was surprised to find that the incubation period had turned into four days.
This sudden change stunned ※8⛬, a look of confusion appeared on his face, and he secretly pondered:
"What's going on? Does this mean that as long as ※0⛬ is continuously injected, these two eggs will never hatch?"
He scratched his head, his brows furrowed, looking bewildered.
However, he quickly calmed down, thinking:
"Never mind, I'll observe for a while first, after all, no one can say for sure what will happen later.
Anyway, for now, ※0⛬ is beneficial to them, so let's maintain the status quo for now."
So, he slowly put the two ※9⛬ Eggs back into the incubator, his movements gentle and cautious, as if afraid of disturbing the little lives incubating inside.
Next, ※8⛬'s gaze fell on the ※6⛬ ※9⛬ Egg, which was a precious ※9⛬ Egg with ※1⛬ potential, worth a lot.
He silently estimated the remaining ※0⛬ in his body, which was probably a little over 20%.
He took a deep breath and first tried to inject 10% of ※0⛬ into the ※6⛬'s egg.
After the injection, he found that this ※9⛬ Egg showed no signs of saturation and seemed to be able to continue absorbing.
※8⛬'s eyes lit up immediately, and a surge of curiosity and desire for exploration rose in his heart.
"Since that's the case, why not try increasing the energy?"
He muttered to himself, then carefully increased the energy transfer step by step.
After some attempts, the ※6⛬ ※9⛬ Egg finally absorbed a full 20% of ※0⛬ before reaching saturation.
※8⛬ looked at the three ※9⛬ Eggs in front of him, forced a wry smile, and was filled with distress:
"These are all big spenders! If this continues, I'll have to conserve ※0⛬ for the next few days, otherwise, I'm afraid I won't even be able to afford these three ※9⛬ Eggs."
His gaze fell on the ※6⛬ ※9⛬ Egg, and he remembered its original incubation period, which should have been nine days remaining at this time today.
However, after this injection of ※0⛬, the incubation period was extended by another day, becoming ten days.
This made ※8⛬ feel a bit depressed, and he couldn't help but suspect:
"These three eggs aren't planning to stay inside forever, are they? Sigh, never mind, I'll take it one step at a time and see how things go later."
He sighed softly, his eyes revealing a complex emotion of helplessness mixed with anticipation.
In the following days, ※8⛬'s life gradually formed a regular rhythm.
During the day, he often accompanied ※2⛬, witnessing it sweat on the training ground, constantly honing itself.
Every time ※2⛬ performed strength training, ※8⛬ would observe with full concentration from the side, giving encouragement and guidance at the right time;
And when ※2⛬ practiced skill techniques, ※8⛬ would carefully use the system to analyze its movements, point out deficiencies, and personally demonstrate the correct way.
Occasionally, ※8⛬ would also take time to visit the city's ※9⛬ breeding house, like a mysterious explorer delving into unknown territory,
There, he would carefully investigate the condition of various ※9⛬, not missing any details, just to collect more valuable data.
As night fell, the lights in ※8⛬'s home would turn on on time, and he would begin to focus on treating ※2⛬.
He first used the system to comprehensively scan ※2⛬'s body, precisely locating every injury and blockage in the energy channels.
Then, his hands slowly condensed ※0⛬, and a gentle light, like a trickling stream, infused into ※2⛬'s body.
While treating, he also did not forget to clear ※2⛬'s internal energy channels; every time he pushed the flow of energy, he was careful, as if carving a rare treasure.
And after completing ※2⛬'s treatment and channel clearing, he would turn his gaze to the ※9⛬ Eggs lying quietly in the incubator.
Speaking of the ※9⛬ Eggs' nurturing, the ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ eggs, after absorbing ※0⛬ three times, showed an interesting change.
Their incubation periods each increased by three days, but fortunately, they no longer extended after that, which greatly relieved ※8⛬, and his worries dissipated.
"Finally, I don't have to worry about them endlessly extending their incubation period anymore, otherwise, I would really have to consider stopping injecting ※0⛬ into them."
※8⛬ muttered to himself, a look of relief on his face.
However, the ※6⛬ ※9⛬ Egg still went its own way; its incubation period remained steadily at ten days.
Each time it absorbed ※0⛬, the incubation period would correspondingly increase by one day.
※8⛬ roughly estimated based on the situation of ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ that the ※6⛬ egg might need about ten days to complete this special "Nirvana Journey."
As a result, its birth time would be postponed to twenty days later.
Although ※8⛬ was somewhat helpless about this, he also knew that a longer incubation time, allowing the ※9⛬ Egg to fully absorb ※0⛬, was greatly beneficial for improving their potential.
Take the ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ eggs, for example; after absorbing ※0⛬, ※8⛬ was pleasantly surprised to find that their potential had increased from the original ordinary ※5⛬ to the valuable ※1⛬.
Although this acquired change did not bring them new inherited skills, it was undoubtedly an exciting and good start, almost like defying fate.
※8⛬ had previously used the system to conduct in-depth analysis of ※3⛬ and ※4⛬; they were originally mediocre in ※5⛬ potential.
If it were according to the normal ※0⛬ clearing method, it would take at least one month to raise their potential to ※1⛬ level.
But now, being able to achieve this goal by just waiting three more days filled ※8⛬ with joy, as if he had found a huge treasure.
"It seems that in the future, it's most cost-effective to raise ※9⛬ from the egg."
※8⛬ secretly sighed in his heart, a hint of enlightenment and anticipation flickering in his eyes.
Time flew by, and five days had passed in a blink of an eye.
Now, the ※0⛬ in ※8⛬'s body, in addition to being used to treat the exhausted and scarred ※2⛬ after daily training, and to clear the complex energy channel blockages in its body,
Only 20% more needs to be reserved for the ※6⛬ ※9⛬ Egg.
Because the ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ eggs are already close to the critical moment of hatching, according to ※8⛬'s speculation, they will most likely ※7⛬ tomorrow.
※8⛬ stood in front of the incubator, his eyes full of anticipation and longing; although ※3⛬ and ※4⛬ are not incredibly powerful ※9⛬,
They excel in their fast growth rate; once hatched successfully, they can grow rapidly, adding a new combat force for ※8⛬, which will undoubtedly be of great help to him in his future adventures.
